events.title: frame again, dream bigger, keep your gallery clean

events.title: tutorial, placement, and pressing; oh my!
events.summary: Thanks for the feedback; this update contains fixes and features that we hope you will enjoy! fix: 'hang this one' now gives a painting a frame of its own shape: a tall view hung again where a wide one hung gets a tall frame instead of being squeezed into the wide one, and its plaque and its place on the wall follow. in a golden hush gallery, a painting that grows wider at the end of a wall now takes the space beside the door, instead of crossing to the other side and leaving its old place empty

events.title: walk among your dreams, under a kinder rain

events.title: the demo is here
events.summary: what's grown since september 21 - your red trees come home: gardens and postcards planted before the maple family arrived show their ember trees again- picture frames rework: the ornate gilt frame is cleaner, the living wood frame's vines finally meet their corners, and dark amber is now called aged silver in the picker- trees, ferns, and grasses now give pressings: when they are fully grown and flourishing, gather offers a leaf for your journal, and its kept color truly tints the plant you grow
